userInputText: Take on the magical world of Touhou in FNF vs Touhou. Challenge powerful characters with mesmerizing rhythms in this epic musical duel.Get lost in the vivid anime world with FNF vs Touhou and start your journey to conquer music! Are you confident in overcoming the adorable but not easy opponents of this cartoon world? All you need to prepare is an interest in the music in the Touhou Project series and excellent reflexes. Each piece of music is an unpredictable challenge. How to conquer the peak scores?A Creative ConceptFNF vs Touhou is a climactic fight inspired by the Touhou Project series. You will enter a colorful anime world where cute characters not only have attractive appearances but also possess excellent fighting techniques. This game will fascinate you with its bright visual design and cool music style that will make you forget the time. Get ready to immerse yourself in unforgettable competitions where speed and accuracy are the keys to victory!Signature GameplayYou will play the role of Boyfriend with the task of overcoming the challenges of all opponents to have the opportunity to approach Girlfriend. In each level, your goal is to keep up with as many notes as possible. You will win if you retain the green color on the score bar when the song ends.Challenge more in the FNF modsFNF Week 6FNF vs MattFNF vs Shaggy
